pieces.heading: Payments > Wires > Cutoff
pieces.text: A domestic wire sent after 5 pm Eastern goes out the next business day. International wires must be submitted by 2 pm.

pieces.heading: Payments > Wires > Fees
pieces.text: An outgoing domestic wire costs 25 dollars and an international wire 45 dollars. Incoming wires are free.

pieces.heading: Deposits > Overdraft
pieces.text: An overdraft fee of 35 dollars applies when a payment takes the balance below zero. It is waived once in twelve months.

pieces.heading: Cards > Disputes
pieces.text: A cardholder disputes a charge within 120 days of the statement date. A provisional credit posts within 10 business days.

pieces.heading: Cards > Lost or stolen
pieces.text: Report a lost or stolen card at once through the app or by phone. The card is blocked and a new one ships within five days.

pieces.heading: Mortgages > Escrow
pieces.text: Escrow is analysed every year. A shortage is spread over the next twelve monthly payments unless paid in full.

pieces.heading: Mortgages > Prepayment
pieces.text: There is no penalty for paying a mortgage early. Extra payments go to principal when marked as such.

pieces.heading: Home equity > Draw period
pieces.text: A home equity line has a ten-year draw period followed by a twenty-year repayment period.

pieces.heading: Deposits > Certificates
pieces.text: Withdrawing from a certificate of deposit before maturity forfeits 90 days of interest on terms under one year.

pieces.heading: Cards > ATM limits
pieces.text: The daily ATM withdrawal limit is 500 dollars. A banker can raise it for one day on request.

pieces.heading: Branches > Hours
pieces.text: Branches open 9 am to 5 pm on weekdays and 9 am to noon on Saturdays. They are closed on federal holidays.

pieces.heading: Branch operations > Cash drawer
pieces.text: A teller drawer holds at most 5,000 dollars. Excess cash goes to the vault before the drawer is balanced.

pieces.heading: Account opening > Identification
pieces.text: Opening an account needs a government photo ID and proof of address dated within the last 90 days.

pieces.heading: Account opening > Joint accounts
pieces.text: Each owner of a joint account must be present or sign the application. Either owner may withdraw the full balance.

pieces.heading: Payments > Person to person
pieces.text: Person-to-person transfers are limited to 2,500 dollars a day and 10,000 dollars a month.

pieces.heading: Lending > Auto loans
pieces.text: Auto loans run from 36 to 84 months. The rate depends on the term, the vehicle's age and the credit score.

pieces.heading: Lending > Late payments
pieces.text: A loan payment more than 15 days late incurs a fee of 4 percent of the payment, at most 40 dollars.

pieces.heading: Insurance > Claims > Notice
pieces.text: Tell us about a home insurance claim within 30 days. Late notice does not cancel cover unless it made the damage harder to assess.

pieces.heading: Insurance > Motor > Windscreen
pieces.text: A windscreen repair is covered with no excess. A replacement carries a 100 dollar excess.

pieces.heading: Telecom > Roaming
pieces.text: Roaming in the EU uses your home allowance. Outside the EU, data costs 5 dollars per day of use.

pieces.heading: Utilities > Outages
pieces.text: After a power outage longer than 24 hours, customers get a credit of 10 dollars per extra day.

pieces.heading: Retail > Returns
pieces.text: Unworn items may be returned within 30 days with a receipt for a full refund. Sale items are final.

pieces.heading: Deposits > Statements
pieces.text: Statements from the last seven years can be downloaded in the app. Older copies are ordered from a branch for 5 dollars each.

pieces.heading: Payments > Checks > Stop payment
pieces.text: A stop payment on a check costs 30 dollars and lasts six months. It can be renewed before it expires.
